title: Malawi's Third Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0)
organization: Government of Malawi, Environmental Affairs Department
temporal_coverage: Observed climate and disaster information and adaptation targets reported in 2026
methodology: Government NDC compiles cited climate information and adaptation targets.
limitations: Impact statistics cite prior studies; adaptation actions are plans, not evaluated outcomes.

title: Climate-Informed Economic Development Key to Malawi's Future Growth and Resilience
temporal_coverage: CCDR headline economic and poverty projections reported in 2022
methodology: World Bank press release summarizes modeled economic, poverty and adaptation findings from Malawi's CCDR.
limitations: The release provides headline estimates but not the model specifications or assumptions behind each estimate.

title: Socio-Economic Effects of El Niño in Malawi: Implications for Recovery and Long-Term Resilience Building
organization: United Nations Malawi and Government of Malawi partners
temporal_coverage: Assessment of the 2023/24 El Niño drought and floods, with outlook material published in 2024.
methodology: UN–government synthesis of crop, education, nutrition and protection sources.
limitations: Secondary synthesis; GBV may be underreported.

title: United Nations Common Country Analysis: Malawi 2024 Update
organization: United Nations Country Team in Malawi
temporal_coverage: Country analysis updated in 2024; mobility and displacement passages include 2022–2024 events.
methodology: UNCT synthesis of national data and consultations.
limitations: Secondary evidence; some estimates lack district detail.

title: State of Malawi Climate in 2024
organization: Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services, Government of Malawi
temporal_coverage: Meteorological observations and reported disaster impacts for calendar year and rainy season 2023/24.
methodology: National weather-station analysis and Department of Disaster Management Affairs incident data.
limitations: Station-based meteorological drought is not the same as agricultural or hydrological drought; disaster counts are reported figures.

title: 2024 UN Country Results Report
organization: United Nations Country Team in Malawi
geographic_coverage: Dzaleka refugee camp and host community
temporal_coverage: Reports on UN Country Framework results and programme outputs during 2024.
methodology: UN agency self-reporting of 2024 programme outputs and results.
limitations: Not an independent impact evaluation; reported outputs do not establish effectiveness. Report publication date is unstated.

title: Malawi Humanitarian Situation Report No. 4, 31 December 2025
temporal_coverage: Operational and needs update for 1 January–31 December 2025; cover dated 26 January 2026.
methodology: UNICEF operational situation report based on programme monitoring and humanitarian response reporting.
limitations: Historical 2025 snapshot; service outputs are not impact evaluations or evidence of current 2026 conditions.
